_comment: dsh-personal-hub 唯一权威清单：个人 DSH 层的完整声明。官方升级后运行 personal_hub_reapply 工具按此清单重建 profile。字段：profileDir=web profile 目录；pluginsDir=自研插件根；officialBundles=官方基底层（reapply 时保持在 bundles 头部）；plugins[].name=插件包名（目录名=包名，id=去 dsh- 前缀）；plugins[].patch.config=cordis.patch.yml 覆盖；extraPatches=非插件绑定的部署覆盖。

patch.comment: deepseek-balance: repoDir/opsDir derive from the sibling layout automatically.
tool-python: pin the interpreter absolutely (3.14.6 via py launcher).
plugin-guide: Chinese plugin guide tab in the Plugins settings section.
restart-resume: auto-continue the session after an AI-triggered service restart.

extraPatches.name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-sandbox
extraPatches.comment: pwsh-sandbox: keep the official sandbox plugin pointed at the local pwsh 7 install.
